CustomField.label: Default Readout Owner
CustomField.description: Username of the fallback owner for an auto-generated readout when no rep can be resolved from the Opportunity, the assessment request or the running user — i.e. a direct guest booking with no Engagement Link. Left blank on purpose: with no fallback configured, readout generation is skipped rather than producing a record owned by the site guest user, which under the Private sharing model would be invisible to every rep and would publish the guest user's contact details to the prospect.
